verdict.rationale: The pack only indirectly shows that official SDKs exist. A customer notes there is "no DD SDK for Elixir/Erlang" and had to fall back to OpenTelemetry, which implies Datadog SDKs exist for other languages but with gaps. The API Reference and APM/tracing docs suggest programmatic surfaces to build against, yet no item explicitly documents official SDK client libraries or their language coverage. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of official SDKs/client libraries and supported languages, coverage for languages like Elixir/Erlang, independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.
